rows.grounds: numeral forming first member of compound with patra
second member of compound describing cakraṃ
attribute indicating presence of a pericarp

items.question: What form and attributes characterize the sixth chakra?
premises: The sixth chakra is the subject of description.
The sixth chakra is characterized as royal.
The sixth chakra has eight petals.
The sixth chakra possesses a pericarp.
items.inference: The sixth chakra is a royal wheel with eight petals and a pericarp.
uncertainties: Whether rājānam is intended as a literal epithet or a symbolic designation is not explicit.
items.plain_english: And the sixth chakra is royal, having eight petals and a pericarp.
